title: RDA DMP Common Standard Schema
description: JSON Schema for the RDA DMP Common Standard v1.0, updated to include the DMPRoadmap and Belnet extensions.

lifecycle_stages.title: The Belnet Extension Lifecycle Stages Schema
lifecycle_stages.description: The Belnet extension to support different stages of a DMP.

modified.title: The Belnet Extension Lifecycle Stages Modified Schema
modified.description: The date and time when the lifecycle stage lists were last modified.

organization.title: The Belnet Extension Organization Schema
organization.description: The organization(s) for which the lifecycle stage lists are defined.

org_id.title: The Belnet Extension Organization Identifier Schema
org_id.description: The unique identifier of the organization.

org_name.title: The Belnet Extension Organization Name Schema
org_name.description: The full name of the organization.

org_abbreviation.title: The Belnet Extension Organization Abbreviation Schema

current_list.title: The Belnet Extension Lifecycle Stages Current List Schema
current_list.description: The current allowed list of DMP lifecycle stages for this organization, ordered from start to finish.

enum.title: The Belnet Extension Lifecycle Stages Current List Enum Schema
enum.description: With `enum` indicate this is a fixed list of values.

items.title: The Belnet Extension Lifecycle Stages Current List Enum Items Schema
items.description: The items in this list. A space is allowed, but no other special characters.

full_list.title: The Belnet Extension Lifecycle Stages Full List Schema
full_list.description: The complete list of DMP lifecycle stages for this organization, always including the default stages and the deprecated stages, ordered from start to finish.

enum.title: The Belnet Extension Lifecycle Stages Full List Enum Schema
enum.description: With `enum` indicate this is a fixed list of values.

items.title: The Belnet Extension Lifecycle Stages Full List Enum Items Schema
items.description: The items in this list. A space is allowed, but no other special characters.
